prompt.en: How high did unemployment reach in 1933, during the Great Depression?
prompt.fr: Quel sommet le chômage a-t-il atteint en 1933, pendant la Grande Dépression?

explanation.en: The stock market crash of 1929 led to the Great Depression, also called the Dirty Thirties. Unemployment reached 27% in 1933 and many businesses were wiped out.
explanation.fr: Le krach boursier de 1929 a mené à la Grande Dépression, aussi appelée les « années trente de misère ». Le chômage a atteint 27 % en 1933 et de nombreuses entreprises ont été ruinées.

source.quote: Unemployment reached 27% in 1933 and many businesses were wiped out.
